item.title: Nintendo Suing U.S. Government Over Tariffs
item.description: Nintendo filed a lawsuit in the United States Court of International Trade. Nintendo of America is suing the United States government over the sweeping tariffs President Donald Trump put in place last year, according to a complaint filed Friday in the U.S. Court of International Trade and obtained by Aftermath.
